statement: Five general calibrated image-point correspondences determine ten complex projective essential matrices.
scope: Essential matrices up to nonzero scalar; not the 20- or 40-solution pose/depth formulations.
notes:
The generic degree10 predates Nistér’s solver and is credited to Demazure 1988 (Theorem 6.4) by later primary literature. Nistér’s contribution is the efficient elimination algorithm; its 10-real numerical example remains separately cited.

The following bibliography supplies historical attribution or supporting background for the result. Michel Demazure, Sur deux problèmes de reconstruction (1988, demazure_1988_reconstruction).
